question: Can the frozen Zankou Skill-to-DoT application and automatically reached Scorch passive be modeled together from saved descriptions and native parameters?
stop_condition: Identify applied stacks, tick lifetime/count and reached Scorch payload/refresh dependencies; implement one complete bounded branch or preserve explicit unsupported behavior and select unrelated supported work.
return_condition: New source mapping/clock/stack/Scorch evidence or concrete cross-source coefficient method enables the blocked producer.
checks: Read frozen DT_ZankouEffectFigure, DT_SkillDamageData, saved Reference guide description and current owner guard. No source package bytes or runtime semantics changed.
decision: unsupported; defer the producer and continue supported Jiuyuan first-attack work
findings: Saved Heartwrench/Vile Ash description and native parameters agree on 1.5% ATK per stack, 1-second period, 30-second duration and cap10. Enhanced Skill applies5 stacks; the ordinary Skill application count/refresh/cadence is not established by these descriptions.

Native Heartwrench damage belongs to GA_Zankou_Melee, while the applying Skill belongs to GA_Zankou_Skill. The current child projector inherits the admitted action coordinate, so it cannot establish the independent Normal-talent coefficient for this cross-action producer.

Automatically reached Silent Sunset reacts to DoT application on Scorch targets and replaces Scorch damage/type/duration. Its replacement payload, attribution, clock/refresh and non-recursive application need to be modeled together; suppressing the existing explicit unsupported guard is not a valid result.
